title: North Dakota AI Laws

reading.body:
North Dakota's only AI-related law is a political-advertising disclosure rule, not a constraint on data centers, power, or compute.

The pattern is narrow. HB1167, passed 2025-04-11, requires a prominent disclaimer on political communications and advertising that use AI-generated digital content to visually or audibly impersonate a human. It exempts AI used for text generation, grammar, spelling, stylistic editing, or enhancing existing content without creating a new impersonation, and it defines artificial intelligence for that purpose.

For AI specifically, this is a transparency requirement aimed at synthetic media in elections. It does not touch the infrastructure layer: nothing in the enrolled text addresses data centers, electricity supply, interconnection, or water. A reader looking for North Dakota's posture on the physical buildout of AI will not find it here.

What the data does not cover is equally important. One law is a count of what this site judged relevant to AI and read from enrolled text, not a census of every bill mentioning the technology. It says nothing about pending legislation, agency rules, or local ordinances, and a single enactment is too thin a base for characterizing the state's broader approach.

North Dakota has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in North Dakota

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • HB1167: Artificial intelligence disclosure statements. passed 2025-04-11

    This North Dakota law requires a prominent disclaimer on political communications and advertising that contain digital content created in whole or in part with artificial intelligence to visually or audibly impersonate a human. It exempts certain uses of artificial intelligence for text generation, grammar, spelling, stylistic editing, or enhancing existing content without creating a new impersonation. It defines artificial intelligence for this purpose.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for North Dakota. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
